title: Height-three coefficient unimodality: reversible forest surgery
objective: Develop and falsify a type-preserving forest split/join construction for lower-half first differences of the (n-4,3,1) elementary coefficient for height-three natural unit interval posets, after P012's retained local obstructions.
deliverables: Exact conditional split/join lemma and comparison with Tom's existing clique construction
Frozen grammar, development and fresh held-out cases, exact complete forest states and minimal failures
At most two proposal/review rounds with one recorded repair and source-bound resource receipts
Universal-argument verdict before any substantial Lean work
success_criteria: Retain every forest, distinct composition assignment, mark and epsilon contributing to the target
Check actual tree validity, type, sign, full inversion-plus-mark degree, inverse recovery and collisions
Separate reciprocal selectors from complete-grammar isolation or verified Hall deficiency
Finite graph matching is diagnostic only; a new unresolved theorem needs a universal proof, coloring bridge, Lean checking and separate semantic review
Preserve all P012 evidence, Lean certificates and publication files
stop_conditions: Two author-critic rounds maximum, with at most one recorded grammar repair; no nested agents
Per round: 600 computation seconds, 5000000 enumeration extensions and 5000000 move candidates
Per case: 120 seconds; one enumeration process, sampled RSS at most 2 GiB and output artifacts at most 250 MiB
Capped cases remain incomplete and are never replaced; held-out cases do not choose a repair
No installations, new dependencies, paid compute or substantial Lean before a credible universal argument
